reading.body:
This entry in OpenStreetMap names a facility "DataPro USA Web Development" in Maricopa County, but the domain dataprousa.com resolves to a parked page marked for sale, and reverse geocoding returns a different current occupant at those coordinates. The research status is exhausted and the record is marked unresolvable. No published capacity specifications exist for this location.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, of which only four have published capacity figures totaling 512 megawatts. This entry would rank fifth by published megawatts if specifications were available, but none are published.

This facility cannot be treated as an active contributor to AI infrastructure capacity. The available evidence suggests it is either mistagged in OpenStreetMap, no longer operating, or operating under a different name and operator. Without published specifications or active confirmation of operation, it does not factor into current assessments of grid constraints on AI scaling in the state.
